youtube_title: Free Delivery Above Rs 199: Pay the Fee or Add More? They're Tricking You #3 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #3. Your cart is Rs 180, delivery is Rs 30, and the app says FREE delivery above Rs 199. A: pay the Rs 30. B: add Rs 40 of something else. Which one?
That threshold is set to make your basket bigger. In a UPS shopper study, 60% of shoppers said they had added items to their cart just to qualify for free shipping.
Answer: if you needed the item anyway, B. If not, A - the Rs 30 fee is cheaper than Rs 40 of stuff you don't need.
Source: UPS Pulse of the Online Shopper (UPS/comScore, 2015).
Are you A or B? Comment below.
